description:
Analysis code, harmonisation and transportability audits, and the de-identified single-centre validation cohort for a Glasgow Coma Scale-free long-term mortality model in critically ill patients with acute brain injury.

What is included. The full analysis pipeline (cohort description and missingness, model development with 28 predictors, external validation, recalibration, and the revision-round audits): aetiology-code leakage sensitivity analysis, GCS-component increment audit, calibration-slope epsilon-dependence audit, bootstrap confidence intervals for calibration metrics, harmonisation/transportability variants, NWICU vasopressor-extraction forensic audit, and the NWICU cohort descriptives. Every audit writes a machine-readable JSON result file; the results/ directory holds those files, including v8_figure_number_manifest.json, which registers every number printed inside every figure together with the JSON path it was derived from.

What is not included. Patient-level source data (PhysioNet data-use agreements forbid redistribution of the source data and of objects derived from it, e.g. extracted cohort CSVs and trained model files) and the manuscript/appendix production scripts. The de-identified local cohort (n = 239 rows) is included. See the README for the exact inclusion/exclusion boundary and how to obtain the rest.
notes: Companion analysis repository. The de-identified local cohort file is released under CC BY 4.0; the code is MIT.
